Subject: Residency & retention for CloudFolio marketplace listing

Hi Tessa / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call today. We have two small follow-ups from our security and product teams to close before listing in the CloudFolio marketplace:

1) Can you confirm the default region mapping for new tenant data created via the marketplace (US vs EU)? We need a clear statement we can include in our listing.
2) Deletion and retention: When a customer triggers a deletion (via CloudFolio UI or API), what are the end-to-end responsibilities and SLA for data-at-rest deletion in each cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure)? Does Redwood issue a deletion confirmation event back to the partner?

Attached a one-page summary of our expected flow. If you can point to the exact doc or playbook we should reference in the marketplace listing that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Jordan

Subject: Re: Residency & retention for CloudFolio marketplace listing

Hi Jordan — great questions. Below is a concise mapping and the operational handoff we use for marketplace partners. Running this by Legal (cc Marissa) for any contractual language tweaks.

1) Region mapping: by default, tenant data created from a marketplace listing inherits the region of the partner's marketplace listing configuration. For CloudFolio we currently map customers to the US region (us-west) unless the customer explicitly selects an EU region at provisioning. We can provide an explicit sentence for your listing: "By default, customer inference and stored artifacts for CloudFolio marketplace provisioning are placed in our US region (us-west). EU-only customers may select EU-region provisioning at signup."

2) Deletion & retention: high-level responsibilities:
- CloudFolio: initiates deletion request via CloudFolio API or the partner console (you should capture the request ID).
- Redwood: upon receipt of an authenticated deletion request, we enqueue a deletion job which performs:
  * removal of active model artifacts and KV cache (fast path, minutes-hours depending on volume)
  * scheduled wipe of cold storage snapshots according to retention windows (72 hours for recent snapshots, full wipe within 30 days),
  * metadata tombstoning and audit trail retention for compliance (retained for contractually agreed period).
- Confirmation: Redwood will emit a deletion-complete webhook to the partner endpoint you configure. If webhook delivery fails, we retry and surface a manual audit record in the Console.

SLA: deletion job acknowledgment within 15 minutes; end-state deletion confirmation dependent on volume and storage class (up to 30 days for deep cold retention). We can tighten the SLO in Dedicated/Private deals.

I've attached our internal deletion playbook (redwood-deletion-playbook-v1.pdf) and a CSV mapping of where tenant artifacts land across clouds for your review.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Partner Solutions — Redwood Inference

Thanks Tessa — that is helpful. Two clarifying items from our security team:

A) For EU-region selections, does Redwood guarantee that backups/snapshots are also pinned to EU storage (i.e., no cross-region replication for durability)?
B) Is the deletion webhook HMAC-signed? Our legal wants to make sure the partner can cryptographically verify deletion confirmations.

Leah (cc'd) — FYI, this is the flow Redwood has provided.

Jordan

>
> 2) Deletion & retention: high-level responsibilities:
> - CloudFolio: initiates deletion request via CloudFolio API or the partner console (you should capture the request ID).
> - Redwood: upon receipt of an authenticated deletion request, we enqueue a deletion job which performs:...

Jordan / Leah — quick answers from Legal/Risk:
A) Cross-region snapshots: Redwood's standard hosted offering does not replicate snapshots across geographic partitions for EU-selected tenants. We maintain region-consistent snapshot placement (no cross-region replication) for customers explicitly provisioned into EU regions. That is our standard for marketplace EU opt-ins.

B) Webhook verification: Yes — deletion/webhook events are signed with an HMAC header (X-Redwood-Signature). We will provide the public key and signature validation doc for your engineers.

If CloudFolio needs stronger guarantees (contractual isolation of backups or dedicated key custody), we can document options available under Dedicated/Private offerings.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
